notes.title: Early Access Patch #15
notes.notes: Tooltips have been added to all the icons on top of screen in game.

notes.title: Early Access Patch #14
notes.notes: When starting a career scenario, it gives some back story, and some help to the new mechanics.

notes.title: The Big Early Access patch #14
notes.notes:
Staff are now more recognizable. 
https://i.imgur.com/hFRFj1g.png


 Career mode 1-4 now progressively adds more management modes each stage to not get overwhelmed. While still allowing you to disable/enable modes to override.
 Simple mode is now replaced with toggles:
 Power management
 hype management
 part management
 When placing walls they go into extend mode. so you don't have to spam walls.
 Staff are easier to click
 By default changing prices/jackpots/etc.. on one machine will change it on all of the same. With ability to toggle it on and off.
 Lightgun, Pinball screens now stay on.
 Lowered music/in game sounds significantly.
 Reward screen has a new clean layout with a hover over effect.
 Prevent accidentally placing floors while clicking on the floor / structure buttons.
 Build menu takes up less space on screen and displays more items.

notes.notes:
Simple Mode can be activated before starting a game no power, parts, hype or prize generators
 Saved/load improvement: (Difficulty, Sandbox Modifiers, Goal progress, Repairmen stats)
 Adjusted UI to be smaller, and added better 16:10 support.

Some known issues: 
- If loading an old game, the goal bar will be slightly sized wrong, when you start a new game it fixes itself.
- When loading The prizes counter at top will not be up to date until a new prize is generated

Can get new staff canidates for $500
Staff candidates refreshes daily, get 3 canidates per staff type a day. 
Staff Speed stat now works and can go up to 10.
New power box / Part workbench models
Fix entrance location on mall level
Hard mode is more difficult (2-3x harder)
Changing difficulty on career mode, changes starting money.
Objective requiring building vending machines, maxes out at 4 vending machines.
Other Minor changes

notes.title: Second Early Access patch
notes.notes:
Second Early Access patch

 Run in background is now in esc menu
 Fixes modifiers: Kids Arcade, Speed Runners spot, Franchise, People Person, MBA Graduate, RoboCade (Robot models coming soon)
 Fixed the light spot on back of arcade machines.
 Prevent deleting level objects like buildings with bulldozer.
 Sandbox mode will now always use the money value you choose.

Thank you for supporting and playing the game. 
More updates will likely come soon. Feel free to give feedback in Discord and Steam Community Discussion.

notes.title: First Early Access Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting Arcade Manager

 - 8 Achievements for completing levels at various difficulties
 - Twilight, Extended Hours, Family Inheritance Modifiers are fixed. More coming soon.
 - Some neon signs have been added to furniture section
 - Some new wall colors are available by selecting wall and pushing "3"
 - When selecting a placeable item, an information panel is displayed to show information about the object.
 - Some bug fixes.


Some major issues will be worked out shortly like saving/loading bugs.
Expect some new content and bug fixes in upcoming updates.

I recommend joining our discord and/or utilizing Steam community discussion page to provide feedback and features you would like to see. 

Thank you.
